benjamin russell.bio: Benjamin Russell is a singer-songwriter and painter from Saskatoon who has lived in Montreal for decades, first known for his 1980s single "Miracle," which earned him a Most Promising Male Vocalist nomination. He has released more than 20 albums, writing and recording with his partner Elyce, and he wrote and recorded his newest work during his diagnosis and treatment for pancreatic cancer. His latest album, Elemental, arrived on Bandcamp on November 4, 2026.

brianna lizotte.bio: Brianna Lizotte is a Métis fiddle player from Edmonton, Alberta, who picked up the fiddle at age ten and later studied music at MacEwan University. Her album Winston & I (2024) earned her a 2025 JUNO nomination for Traditional Indigenous Artist or Group of the Year, and she performs and teaches Métis history through music and dance across Alberta. Her third album, Blood Memory, was released on November 4, 2026.

comeback kid.bio: Comeback Kid are a hardcore punk band from Winnipeg, Manitoba, formed in the early 2000s and fronted by vocalist Andrew Neufeld. Since their 2003 debut Turn It Around, Neufeld, guitarists Jeremy Hiebert and Stu Ross, bassist Chase Brenneman and drummer Terrance Pettitt have carried Winnipeg hardcore to stages around the world. Their eighth studio album, Chosen Hell, was released on November 6, 2026, via Dine Alone Records.

hayden.bio: Hayden is the stage name of Toronto singer-songwriter Paul Hayden Desser, who emerged in the mid-1990s with Everything I Long For (1995), released on Hardwood Records, the label he founded in 1994. A three-time JUNO nominee, he has spent three decades making intimate, largely self-produced records, most of them recorded at home. His tenth studio album, The Recent Past, was released on November 6, 2026.

taylor ashton.bio: Taylor Ashton is a Canadian singer-songwriter and banjo player raised in Vancouver, where he fronted the folk band Fish & Bird through four albums in his teens and twenties. Now based in Brooklyn, he has built a solo career on witty, banjo-led folk, recording and touring with members of the New York folk scene. His third solo album, Charades, was released on November 6, 2026, on Birthday Cake Records.

yoo doo right.bio: Yoo Doo Right are a Montreal experimental rock duo — Justin Cober on guitars, bass VI, lap steel, synthesizers, piano and tape recordings, and John Talbot on drums and percussion — formed in 2016. Their wall-of-sound blend of krautrock, post-rock and psychedelia has twice landed them on the Polaris Music Prize long list, in 2022 and 2023. Their fourth full-length, Build and Rest by the Shepherd's Light, was released on November 6, 2026, via Mothland.
album_titles: Build and Rest by the Shepherd's Light

lammping.bio: Lammping are a Toronto duo — producer, guitarist and vocalist Mikhail Galkin, also known as DJ Alibi, and drummer Jay Anderson of Comet Control and Biblical — who fold psychedelic rock together with hip-hop rhythms and sampled textures. So What, What? is the third instalment of a planned four-album cycle that began with Never Never (2025) and continued with Risky (2026). Their fifth full-length, So What, What?, was released on November 6, 2026, via We Are Busy Bodies.

tennyson king.bio: Tennyson King is a Hong Kong-born, Toronto-based indie folk singer-songwriter whose Chinese name, 百城 (Baak Sing), translates to "100 Cities." An award-winning touring musician — Songwriter of the Year at the 2022 Mississauga Music Awards and Vocalist of the Year at the 2023 MARTYs — he layers traditional Chinese instruments into his folk songwriting. His album 100 Cities 百城, nearly five years in the making, was released on November 6, 2026.

janky bungag.bio: Janky Bungag is a Filipino-Canadian flatpicker from Vancouver, British Columbia, who makes fast-picking alt-country with a bluegrass streak. He picked up the guitar during the pandemic and has since signed with Royal Mountain Records, building a following through solo and full-band shows across Canada. His sophomore album, Hangin' Out & Hangin' On, was released November 6, 2026, on Royal Mountain Records.

laura niquay.bio: Laura Niquay is an Atikamekw singer-songwriter from Wemotaci, in Québec's Mauricie region, who sings in her own language. Her 2021 album Waska Matisiwin made the Polaris Music Prize long list and won two Félix awards at the 2022 ADISQ gala, including Indigenous Artist of the Year. Her third studio album, Nir Wactenama — "I, the Light," sung entirely in Atikamekw — was released November 6, 2026, on Musique Nomade.

young friend.bio: young friend is the project of Vancouver songwriter Drew Tarves, whose background in hip-hop and dance feeds a confessional strain of indie pop and rock. After two EPs, his 2025 debut full-length motorcycle sound effects earned a JUNO nomination. His sophomore album, New Entertainment, recorded live off the floor and fully analog with producer David Marinelli, was released November 6, 2026, on Nettwerk.

sechile sedare.bio: Sechile Sedare is the duo of Dene sibling songwriters Leela and Jay Gilday, born and raised in Yellowknife, Northwest Territories — the name means "my younger brother, my older sister" in the Dene language. Leela is a two-time JUNO Award winner and Jay has four solo records behind him; together they write story-songs rooted in family, land and water. Their self-titled debut full-length was released November 6, 2026, on Diva Sound Records.

les moontunes.bio: Les Moontunes are a seven-piece band of Acadian musicians from Moncton, New Brunswick, formed in 2015 and named Music NB's Breakthrough Artist of the Year in 2021. Their cosmic, groove-heavy progressive rock runs on two drummers, synths and stacked group harmonies. Their third studio album, Cyborg Slayer — their first sung entirely in Chiac — was released November 6, 2026, on Acadian Embassy.

clay pigeon.bio: clay pigeon is the songwriting vehicle of James Clayton, who was born in Peterborough, Ontario and now lives in Montreal, where he cut his debut at the city's storied Hotel2Tango studio. His alt-country songs favour tape warmth and plainspoken storytelling. His sophomore album, Cash Out in Kid Gloves, was released independently on November 6, 2026.

é.t.é.bio: É.T.É is a Montréal trad trio — Élisabeth Moquin on fiddle, Élisabeth Giroux on cello and Thierry Clouette on Irish bouzouki — whose name joins the French word for summer to the members' initials. Formed in 2015, they play original compositions and arrangements of Québécois and Acadian repertoire, with step-dancing and foot percussion in the mix. Their fourth album, Aronde, named for an old word for the swallow, was released November 6, 2026.

jacob do.bio: Jacob Do is an Edmonton-based tenor saxophonist working in the bebop tradition, a McGill University graduate who studied with Rémi Bolduc and leads bands built from mentors and longtime collaborators. His earlier live EP Maybe was recorded at the Yardbird Suite, the Edmonton room where he also launched his first full-length. That debut album, First Chorus, featuring a guest spot from Order of Canada recipient PJ Perry, was released November 6, 2026, on Bent River Records.

shiloh lindsey.bio: Shiloh Lindsey is a Vancouver-based singer-songwriter raised in rural Alberta who has been releasing alt-country and Americana records since her 2005 debut For My Smoke. A motorcycle accident in 2024 that nearly cost her a leg reshaped her writing, and the songs that followed became her first full-length in almost a decade. That record, The Western Veil, was released on November 6, 2026.

nova spei.bio: Nova Spei are a French-language modern metal band from Trois-Rivières, Quebec, formed in 2012 by guitarist Dany Soucy. The band rebuilt its lineup in 2025 around new vocalist Emmanuelle Desbiens-Dubois and lead guitarist Cédrick Charland, and has played more than 100 shows across Quebec and Ontario. Their third full-length, Trinitas, was released on November 6, 2026, on Bam&Co-Heavy.

renforshort.bio: renforshort is the project of Toronto singer-songwriter Lauren Isenberg, who broke through in 2019 with the singles "Waves" and "Mind Games," the latter a SOCAN Songwriting Prize nominee. EPs Teenage Angst (2020) and Off Saint Dominique (2021) led to her debut album Dear Amelia in 2022. Her second album, Hotel 13, was released on November 13, 2026, ahead of a seven-city Canadian tour in February 2027.

land of talk.bio: Land of Talk is the Montreal indie rock band led by songwriter Elizabeth Powell, who formed the group in 2006 and built a catalogue around albums like Some Are Lakes (2008) and Life After Youth (2017). Powell recorded the band's sixth album in a cabin in Harrington, in rural Quebec, with Michael Feuerstack and Michael Belyea. LASTS was released on November 13, 2026, via Saddle Creek and Next Door.

fog lake.bio: Fog Lake is the lo-fi recording project of Aaron Powell, from Glovertown, Newfoundland and Labrador, who has built a devoted following on hushed, home-recorded albums including Dragonchaser (2017) and Captain (2018). Hollowbody, his seventh Fog Lake album and first since 2023's Midnight Society, was written over three weeks back home in Newfoundland and co-produced with longtime collaborator Warren Hildebrand. It was released on November 13, 2026.

fucked up.bio: Fucked Up are a Toronto hardcore punk band formed in 2001, fronted by Damian Abraham, whose second album The Chemistry of Common Life won the 2009 Polaris Music Prize. Alongside their regular albums, the band has spent twenty years on a parallel Zodiac series of concept records that began with Year of the Dog in 2006. Grass Can Move Stones Part 3: Year of the Rooster, the final instalment of the Zodiac series, was released on Bandcamp on November 13, 2026.
album_titles: Grass Can Move Stones Part 3: Year of the Rooster

shaina hayes.bio: Shaina Hayes is a Montreal-based folk-pop singer-songwriter who grew up in Shigawake, in Quebec's Gaspésie, studied agricultural science at McGill, and still runs a vegetable farm in Shigawake alongside her music. Her first two albums, to coax a waltz (2022) and Kindergarten Heart (2024), led to opening slots for The War on Drugs, The Barr Brothers and Elisapie. Her third album, Take the Case of a Rose, was released on November 13, 2026, on Bonsound.
album_titles: Take the Case of a Rose
